checks.name: server resolves point identity and snapshots actual rate; checkout and repeats never call CDEK under SQL locks
unknown package and multiple units need a packing rule; no guessed dimension or tariff
ordinary and preorder get independent quotes, and preorder has no early reserve
provider failure keeps total unknown and manager can complete shipping safely
manual address stays manual even when the API works
invalid city or wrong-city point cannot become a paid delivery quote
no cart/stock locks during carrier request; price changes during network invalidate the quote
package changes after a quote force review without reserving anything
stock repartition or origin changes invalidate confirmed rates
expired and foreign-session quotes are rejected
